profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company (ticker: DBX) founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, CA. Its core offering is secure cloud storage with file sharing and collaboration tools. The company describes itself as enabling users to organize content in one place, with support for previews across 175+ file types, synced team folders, and a product called Dash aimed at helping teams manage company content more efficiently.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings, which provides document summaries, sharing controls, and integration with external AI platforms. The company's site describes the ability to connect Dropbox with leading AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, with built-in AI summaries noted as coming soon. Dropbox is also present in the MCP ecosystem through a third-party server that allows users to search, browse, and read Dropbox files and list folders by name or content.

According to SEC filings, Dropbox reported revenue of $2,521,000,000 for the period ending December 31, 2025, filed under a 10-K. The company carries a notable litigation footprint, with 174 cases recorded in California.
